title: Fate Writer
next_chapter_hook: Just as the illusory figure was about to dissipate, an ancient jade slip materialized out of thin air, and the power of the Fifth Page flowing upon it caused Chen Ji's pupils to constrict—this was a massive trump card capable of rewriting the entire chess game.

text.content: As Chen Ji sat alone in the quiet room deducing, a thought that made his spine go cold emerged—the 'fall' of Chen Tianming all those years ago might have been a meticulously designed chess game from start to finish. The moonlight outside the window was frost-like, yet he felt a bone-piercing chill around him, as if countless eyes were peering at him through the void. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm grew slightly hot, as if responding to some ancient summoning. Just as he was about to think deeper, his consciousness fell like into an abyss, plunging into a chaotic void.

In the dream, there was no distinction between heaven and earth, only gray mist churning around. Chen Ji stood in nothingness, yet his divine sense was unprecedentedly clear—this was no ordinary illusion, but some higher-level existence actively contacting him. He unconsciously activated the Tianji Record Fragment, but the familiar foresight was blocked by an invisible barrier. "Who?" His voice echoed in the void, but there was no response.

dialogue.content: "No need to be nervous, Chen Ji." An aged and distant voice rang out from all directions simultaneously, "I have been waiting for you for quite some time." As the voice fell, the gray mist suddenly parted, and a illusory figure slowly materialized. It was a figure with no discernible features, surrounded by countless tiny points of light, like a miniature star map. With each step he took, the void trembled slightly, as if unable to bear the weight of his existence.

"Who are you?" Chen Ji suppressed the agitation in his heart, his gaze sharp as a blade locking onto that figure. The aura of the Tianji Record was completely blocked; he could not glimpse even three breaths of the future from here. This loss of control made him instinctively uneasy, but years of tempering had made him remain composed on the surface. The illusory figure seemed to sense something and let out a meaningful chuckle.

"Who am I?" The voice carried a hint of self-mockery, "Even I have forgotten this question. But you more often call me by another name—Fate Writer." He waved his hand, and a blurry image emerged from the gray mist: countless worlds floated like bubbles in the void, and the surface of each world was inscribed with dense patterns, those patterns... were being written by some kind of force.

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that image, his heart surging with immense waves. Those patterns were too familiar to him—they were the trajectories of fate, the chains of cause and effect, seemingly identical to the foresight displayed by the Tianji Record, yet fundamentally different. The Tianji Record was to peek, while the power in that image was to write directly. "You say you can rewrite fate?" He spoke, his voice even hoarser than he had anticipated.

dialogue.content: "Rewrite?" The Fate Writer gently shook his head, "That's too low-level. I am the rule-maker, the weaver of the chessboard." He stepped forward, the illusion becoming even more solid, and Chen Ji finally vaguely saw his face—it was a face without features, smooth as a mirror, yet profound as an abyss. "But tragically, even I am but a piece in a larger game of chess."

text.content: "A larger game of chess?" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes; his intuition from years of dealing with the Tianji Record told him that what this existence said was true. What kind of enormous entity could make the Fate Writer call himself a piece? His mind raced rapidly, connecting known information: the Will of Heavenly Dao, the ultimate truth of the Tianji Record, Chen Tianming's fall... all clues pointed to the same chilling possibility.

dialogue.content: "You guessed it." A hint of praise appeared in the Fate Writer's voice, "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not as simple as you thought. It is the projection of this world's will, the core that maintains the operation of the Three Realms—but at the same time, it is also a piece placed by higher beings." His voice suddenly lowered, "And the Tianji Record is precisely one of the countless pieces this ultimate chess player has placed in this world."

text.content: Chen Ji felt as if something exploded in his mind. All these years, he thought he was battling the Will of Heavenly Dao, believed the Tianji Record was a weapon against heaven, yet never realized from the start he was merely a puppet dancing on strings in a larger game. Anger,不甘, fear... various emotions intertwined and surged, but he quickly suppressed them all. Anger solves no problems; only by surviving can there be a chance to turn the tables.

dialogue.content: "You don't need to be so wary." The Fate Writer seemed to see through his thoughts, "If I wanted to harm you, I wouldn't meet you in this way." He raised his hand, and an ancient bamboo slip appeared in the void, exactly like the Tianji Record Fragment, "In fact, I am also an early holder of the Tianji Record. Before you, it had countless masters—including the existence that created it."

choice.prompt: The Fate Writer threw out an astonishing truth and seemed to be waiting for Chen Ji's response. What does he actually want?

choices.description: Since the other party took the initiative to appear, they must have an agenda. Better to hear their conditions first, then calculate.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence and support from the third faction
choices.risk_hint: The Fate Writer's true purpose is still unclear

dialogue.content: "Cooperation?" Chen Ji said coldly, "First clarify what you want, and what price I need to pay." His gaze was sharp as a blade,直视那张没有五官的脸， "There is no free lunch in this world. Since you came to me, you must have already calculated the value I can provide."

choices.description: This person's origins are unknown and cannot be trusted lightly. Better to use words to probe, extracting more information about their identity and purpose.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity for cooperation
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more secrets about the Fate Writer
choices.risk_hint: The other party may see through the probe and lose patience

dialogue.content: "Since you can enter my dream, you must be well aware of my situation." Chen Ji probed without changing his expression, "Then I want to know, in your eyes, what kind of chess piece am I?" His tone was flat, but his mind was rapidly calculating—if the other party truly knows everything, how many trump cards do I have left?

choices.description: A mysterious existence actively recruiting must have ulterior motives. Better to miss the opportunity than recklessly enter the game.
choices.visible_cost: May offend a powerful potential ally
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence and not be entangled by karma
choices.risk_hint: The Fate Writer's attitude may change as a result

dialogue.content: "No need." Chen Ji's voice was cold and firm, "I, Chen Ji, never rely on others' charity, nor make deals with beings of unknown origin." He stared at that illusory figure, "If you truly have sincerity, show your identity first, then we can discuss the rest."

The Fate Writer was silent for a moment, and a complex emotion seemed to appear on that smooth, mirror-like face. "You are very cautious, and that's good." He slowly said, "But I must tell you that the Eye of Heavenly Dao has already noticed you. Its plan, ten thousand years in the making, will not allow any variables to exist—and you are precisely the biggest variable."

"My proposal is very simple." The Fate Writer's voice became solemn, "You and I join forces to oppose the cosmic will of that ultimate chess player. You have the Tianji Record, I have the power of writing—when combined, perhaps we can break this ancient chess game." He paused, "Of course, I know you won't believe easily. So I'm willing to give my sincerity first—do you want to know the truth about Chen Tianming?"

text.content: The truth about Chen Tianming! These five words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. His father, that legendary fallen genius, that mysterious figure who left behind the Tianji Record Fragment—behind all this, what secrets were hidden? He stared intently at the Fate Writer, hands unconsciously clenched into fists. Deep in his heart, a voice was frantically urging him to agree.

dialogue.content: "I know what you're thinking." The Fate Writer seemed to see through everything about him, "Your father did not die. At least, not entirely at the hands of the Eye of Heavenly Dao." His voice became meaningful, "The choice Chen Tianming made back then was far more complex than you imagined. And the arrangements he left behind... are precisely paving the way for your awakening today."

text.content: The gray mist in the dream suddenly churned violently, and Chen Ji felt his consciousness being pulled by some force. He knew this dream wouldn't last much longer. This existence calling itself the Fate Writer had given him a shock far beyond imagination—the truth of the Tianji Record, the details of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the secret of Chen Tianming... each piece of information was enough to overturn all his previous understanding.

dialogue.content: "Time is running out." The Fate Writer's figure began to become illusory, "You must make a decision quickly—whether to continue fighting the Eye of Heavenly Dao alone, or choose to cooperate with me. Whatever you choose, there is one thing I must remind you:" his voice suddenly lowered, "Chen Nian's disappearance is related to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. She is the true key in this chess game... and your greatest weakness."

choice.prompt: The warning about Chen Nian made Chen Ji's heart一震, and as the dream was about to dissipate, he had to make a final response.

choices.description: The Fate Writer holds key intelligence about Chen Nian and may be worth the risk.
choices.visible_cost: May be schemed against by the other party
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence about Chen Nian and initial support from the Fate Writer
choices.risk_hint: Once judgment is wrong, may lose everything

dialogue.content: "...Fine, I temporarily trust you." Chen Ji said word by word, yet the coldness in his eyes was丝毫没有减弱， "But if I find you have any deception—regardless of who it is, my ability to bear grudges, you must be aware of."

choices.description: Intelligence can be listened to, but cooperation requires more leverage. Obtain information first, keep options open.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain partial information without completely binding oneself
choices.risk_hint: The Fate Writer may hold back as a result

dialogue.content: "I'm willing to listen to your intelligence, but the matter of cooperation, let's discuss it later." Chen Ji's tone was neither humble nor overbearing, "I need time to consider, and I also need... to verify the truth of what you said." His gaze was profound as a deep pool, "If you truly have sincerity, you shouldn't mind giving me some time to think."

Just as the dream was about to collapse, the Fate Writer's figure suddenly wavered, and countless points of light peeled off from him,凝聚成一枚古朴的玉简 in the void. That jade slip emitted an aura completely different from yet faintly connected to the Tianji Record, as if bearing some kind of power beyond the Three Realms. "This is my final sincerity." The Fate Writer's voice had already become ethereal as wind, "The power of the Fifth Page in the Tianji Record is enough to temporarily free you from the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—but remember, this is only the beginning."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly awoke from the dream, cold sweat already soaking his back. Everything in the quiet room was as usual, except there was an unfamiliar cold touch in his palm—the jade slip had actually appeared in his hand. He lowered his head to gaze at the mysterious patterns flowing on the jade slip, his heart surging with immense waves. This was not an illusion, but real causal power—what the Fate Writer said was probably not false. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, Chen Tianming, the ultimate truth of the Tianji Record... all the mysteries had become even more intricate and complicated at this moment.

Outside the window, the east was already showing the first light of dawn. A new day was about to begin, and he, Chen Ji, was about to embark on an even more perilous journey. The appearance of the Fate Writer made him realize this chess game was far vaster than he had imagined—but at the same time, that jade slip bearing the power of the Fifth Page also gave him his first glimpse of the possibility of breaking the chess game. His sister Chen Nian's whereabouts, his father's true cause of death, the complete form of the Tianji Record... all the answers await him to pursue.

Just as the illusory figure was about to dissipate, an ancient jade slip materialized out of thin air, and the power of the Fifth Page flowing upon it caused Chen Ji's pupils to constrict—this was a massive trump card capable of rewriting the entire chess game. In the quiet room, Chen Ji held that warm jade slip, his thoughts churning like tides. The Fate Writer's words still echoed in his ears, the threat of the Eye of Heavenly Dao was imminent, and the truth about Chen Tianming and Chen Nian was like a lighthouse in the mist, guiding him step by step into a deeper vortex.
